NO IDEAS? START WITH A LITTLE INSPIRATION.
Made for curious ears.Record. Explore. Repeat.

Your mouth, in between.

Record any two mouth-made sounds: vowels, humming, lip buzzes, whistles, breath, hisses, or clicks. A clear, held sound works best.

Press Play morph. We prepare each sound once, ignore silence, and sustain a new sound as you move the slider. AH → MM uses the same resonance morph; unvoiced sounds use a spectral texture morph.

Your pair stays saved in this browser through pauses and reloads. The microphone turns off after each recording. Press Start over to erase both recordings and their analysis and record a new pair.

The result is a synthesized approximation. A click becomes a sustained texture; words and original clip timing are not replayed. Recordings are stored locally, not uploaded. If browser storage is blocked, the pair lasts only in this tab.
